info.description: Options and pricing for the custom seat cover configurator page

turnaroundNote.description: e.g. "Ready in 3-5 days" — shown near the price

carTypes.description: Array of { label, price }, e.g. [{"label":"Hatchback","price":3500}]. price is the full set price for that car type.

materials.description: Array of { label, priceAdd, description }, e.g. [{"label":"Leatherette","priceAdd":0,"description":"Durable and easy to clean"}]. priceAdd is added to (or subtracted from) the car type's base price.

stitchingOptions.description: Array of { label, hex }. Use hex: null for a "Matching" option that follows the main color.
